decision: XMSInit sets up ExtMemSA and xmem.c allocates through DpmiAllocateVirtualMemory. nt_mem.c VdmQueryFreeVirtualMemory returns STATUS_SUCCESS with totalFree and free headerTable extents, so the original STATUS_NOT_IMPLEMENTED fallback would skip the XMS query. VdmReallocateVirtualMemory likewise indexes headerTable, whereas SAReallocate takes ExtMemSA and the old byte count. Keep allocation, release, resize and free-space reporting with the same suballocator. Restored original local Status and query closing brace, aligned the four scopes and removed the redundant local comment. DIV-224 remains registered.
line_check: All retained nonempty lines match the original at logical coordinates except the four intentional replacements of fallback condition with unconditional block at 66, 115, 169, 242.

verification.objects: Worker and worker-reference x86 rebuilt. Both COFF objects identical to respective starting object except timestamp. C4101 for restored original Status at 216.
verification.scope: The XMS fixture exercises the shared suballocator, not DPMI guest execution.
